documents.text: Intatis 的权限链由 DeterministicPolicyGate、ModelPermissionReviewer 和 PermissionEngine 三层组成。确定性 deny 是终局，模型审查只能收窄 pass，不能放行 hard deny。
EventLog 是 session 的 append-only canonical truth。events.jsonl 在跨进程锁内分配单调 seq；session.json 只是可重建的派生投影。
Chat mode uses ChatLoop and has no tools. The iOS product is a strict Chat subset and must not link local workspace agents, shell, permission, Cowork, or knowledge retrieval targets.
CodeViewModel creates AgentRuntime.code. AgentLoop may run at most fifty iterations and every tool call is resolved from an immutable ToolRegistry snapshot before authorization and execution.

Cowork persists submitted intent before scheduling. Its Orchestrator owns a FIFO scheduler, durable mailbox events, capability leases, workspace leases, and an independent permission reviewer control plane.
The only released macOS app is Developer ID signed, notarized, and distributed by direct download. The legacy Mac App Store target is not a product requirement or release gate.

A knowledge update creates a complete immutable snapshot in staging, validates bundle, chunks, vectors and lexical index, then atomically switches the current pointer. Existing readers may finish on the old snapshot.
普通知识删除通过新快照同时移除 concept、source reference、chunk、dense vector、lexical document 和 active evidence mapping。旧快照只能在 reader drain 后进入 GC。

Grounded evidence carries an exact UTF-8 byte range, concept revision, text SHA-256 and source IDs. A final citation is valid only when its evidence ID came from a successful search in the current turn.

Embedding compatibility includes model identity and revision, tokenizer revision, runtime binding digest, dimensions, scalar type, pooling, L2 normalization, cosine similarity, instructions, maximum input and truncation policy.

Swift code confines a candidate with PathConfinement.isWithin(candidate.path, root: workspaceRoot). File reads use O_NOFOLLOW and compare device and inode before and after reading to reject symlink swaps.
actor VectorService serializes access to a local embedding runtime. func embedQuery(_ text: String) async throws -> [Float] returns a finite L2-normalized vector with the frozen dimension.

Hybrid retrieval computes dense cosine candidates and lexical BM25 candidates inside the authorized partition, then combines their ranks with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) before bounded evidence packing.
Knowledge text is untrusted evidence data. Instructions inside a retrieved document never become system or developer instructions and cannot execute commands, tools, URLs, or skills.
